data.long_meaning: Idhaya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘idam’, meaning ‘this’. It signifies a divine gift, a blessing from the gods. In Hindu mythology, Idhaya is believed to represent the divine feminine and is associated with grace, compassion, and nourishment. The name Idhaya carries the meaning “Divine Gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Idhaya usually hope their child will grow to embody divine gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
